title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 4: the tile with Jerusalem on it, lying on each side, and bread weighed out by the day.

questions.text: What was he told to portray on a tile laid before him?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 4:1 tells him to take a tile, lay it before himself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.

answers.text: The mountains of Israel
A city, even Jerusalem
A scroll written within and without
Four living creatures

questions.text: What was he to set up against the city he portrayed?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 4:2 tells him to lay siege against it, build forts, cast up a mound, set camps and plant battering rams against it all around.

answers.text: Forts, a mound, camps and battering rams
A wall of stones and a gate
An altar and incense altars
Ropes and chains

questions.text: What was to serve as a wall of iron between him and the city?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 4:3 tells him to take an iron pan and set it for a wall of iron between himself and the city.

answers.text: A bronze shield
An iron rod
A curtain of linen
An iron pan

questions.text: How many days was he to lie on his left side, bearing the iniquity of the house of Israel?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 4:5 says God appointed the years of their iniquity to him as a number of days, even three hundred ninety days.

answers.text: One hundred twenty days
Two hundred seventy days
Three hundred ninety days
Four hundred thirty days

questions.text: Lying on his right side, whose iniquity was he to bear, and for how long?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 4:6 says that on his right side he shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah, for which God appointed forty days, each day for a year.

answers.text: The house of Judah, for forty days
The house of Israel, for forty days
The house of Judah, for three hundred ninety days
The house of David, for seven days

questions.text: How was he to prophesy against the siege of Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 4:7 tells him to set his face toward the siege of Jerusalem with his arm uncovered, and prophesy against it.

answers.text: With his eyes closed and his head covered
With his head and beard shaved
Standing on the wall of the city
With his face set toward it and his arm uncovered

questions.text: Which foods was he to put in one vessel to make bread?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 4:9 tells him to take wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, put them in one vessel and make bread of it.

answers.text: Wheat, oil, honey, figs and new wine
Wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt
Barley, figs, raisins, dates and olives
Flour, salt, water and nothing besides

questions.text: What daily amounts of food and water were set for him?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 4:10-11 says his food was to be by weight, twenty shekels a day, and he was to drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin.

answers.text: Ten shekels of food and half a hin of water
Twenty shekels of food and a whole hin of water
Twenty shekels of food and a sixth part of a hin of water
Forty shekels of food and a third of a hin of water

questions.text: After he objected, what was he given to prepare his bread on instead of man's dung?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 4:15 says God answered him, "I have given you cow's dung for man's dung, and you shall prepare your bread on it."

answers.text: Wood from the field
Coals of fire from the altar
Ashes from the hearth
Cow's dung

questions.text: What did Yahweh say he would break in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 4:16 says God will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem, so they eat bread by weight with fearfulness and drink water by measure in dismay.

answers.text: The gates of the city
The bow of the mighty
The staff of bread
The yoke of the nations
